description: Renovate updates each version of the image with a built-in manager: dockerfile (the sid, mise and uv images), mise (mise.toml and mise.lock), npm (npm/), pip-compile (python/) and github-actions. The apt packages float with sid, and the daily rebuild takes their updates.

packageRules.description: The tools of the image come in one pull request for their non-major updates.
semgrep pins mcp==1.29.0, also in its newest release (1.186.0 on 2026-11-18), so uv finds no lock with the security fix. The hold ends when the lock takes the fix.
semgrep pins opentelemetry-api~=1.37.0, also in its newest release (1.186.0 on 2026-11-18), so uv finds no lock with the security fix. The hold ends when the lock takes the fix.
